title: Normalized coordinates of the underived product internal bar
statement: Let A be a commutative condensed ring and G,H profinite groups in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], with internal modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] and internal functions F characterized on every profinite base change as in [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data]. Use the free represented modules A[P] of [def-sfb-condensed-free-module-adjunction] and the action categories of [lem-sfb-condensed-product-action-inflation]. There exists an additive bicosimplicial product bar B, with its section, restriction, face, degeneracy and augmentation formulas prescribed by the inhomogeneous product bar. There are generator-normalized isomorphisms A[P times Q] ≅ A[P] tensor_A A[Q], coefficient-natural currying isomorphisms F(P times Q) ≅ F(Q) followed by F(P), and coefficient-natural column isomorphisms B^{a,b} ≅ U followed by F(G^a times H^b). Currying evaluates successively on g:T→P and h:W→Q after k:W→T as direct evaluation on (g composed with k,h) after k followed by f:T→S. The column isomorphism evaluates a section x after f and the parameter tuples by pulling B.sections(x) back along their graph. Finally there is a single (G times H)-bar diagram and an isomorphism from the full diagonal of B to it, evaluated by reordering a tuple of pairs into its two coordinate tuples. All simplex operators, including both first action faces and identity insertions, are retained. This statement has no resolution, derived comparison or augmentation quasi-isomorphism assertion.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-condensed-free-linearization-tensor] to representable profinite P,Q. The Yoneda product comparison identifies their Cartesian product with represented P times Q. The inverse tensor comparison sends [(p,q)] to [p] tensor [q]. Apply [def-sfb-modobj-internal-hom] twice and identify maps out of any test module with maps from its tensor with A[P] tensor A[Q]. The corresponding counits give the displayed successive evaluation and coefficient naturality.

proof.text: Use the natural generalized families of [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data]. Their represented section formula is M(S times G^a times H^b). Substitute the inhomogeneous parameter faces; the first faces act on M by (g,1) and (1,h), and degeneracies insert identities. Associativity and the action and unit laws prove all one-direction cosimplicial identities. The mixed operators change disjoint tuples, except the first faces, which commute since (g,1)(1,h)=(1,h)(g,1). These linear restriction-compatible formulas define B on both simplex categories. The represented adjunction gives the column isomorphism and its graph evaluation.

proof.text: The continuous inverse coordinate maps ((g_i,h_i)) ↔ ((g_i),(h_i)) give inverse free maps by [lem-sfb-condensed-free-linearization-tensor]. Precomposition gives diagonalIso. The diagonal first face acts by (g,h); interior faces multiply pairs, final faces omit the last pair and degeneracies insert (1,1). Thus the entire cosimplicial diagram agrees with the single product-group bar and has precisely the asserted evaluation. Empty tuples and trivial factors require no discarded degrees.
